body.message:
Krishnakshee, for a furnished studio all-inclusive in Business Bay, the closest we have is a studio in Bayz by Danube at AED 4,400/month. VAT, water, electricity, and internet are all covered, so nothing extra beyond that.

It's a little over your 4k budget. Want to take a look at the listing? https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-bayz-by-danube-13851930.html
